description: WE ARE ENGINEERING STUDENTS AND WANT TO DEVELOP AN GAME THROUGH WHICH EVERYONE CAN UNDERSTAND AND LEARN THE SPACE MISSIONS THROUGH STIMULATED GAME WHERE THEY WILL BE  DOING MISSION PLANNING TO COMPLETION
summary:
SPACE-AURA is an interactive, browser-native 3D space mission simulator bridging concurrent systems engineering with real-time orbital spaceflight. Inspired by NASA JPL Team X, SPACE-AURA introduces a 4-Player Collaborative Mission Design Lab where teams step into real flight roles—Mission Commander, Flight Dynamics Officer, Systems Engineer, and Science Payload Director—to balance rigid mass growth margins, solar flux power budgets, RF link margins, and financial caps.

Once certified, crews transition into an authentic 60 FPS WebGL launch and orbital flight arena. Players command multi-stage launch vehicles (NASA SLS, Falcon Heavy, and ISRO LVM3 "Bahubali"), executing gravity turns, atmospheric staging, solar panel cosine alignment, high-frequency laser downlinks to ground networks, and collision avoidance maneuvers against active satellites.

By simulating real flagship campaigns—including NASA-ISRO NISAR, Artemis II, Chandrayaan-3, and Aditya-L1—SPACE-AURA transforms dry aerospace equations into an accessible, high-adrenaline collaborative challenge, inspiring the next generation of space engineers with zero installation required.
details:
WHAT DOES IT DO & HOW DOES IT WORK?

SPACE-AURA is built on a dual-core architecture:

1. Collaborative Mission Design Lab (MDL): Modeled after NASA JPL Team X concurrent engineering. A team balances launch vehicle payload capacity, orbital inclination, solar irradiance, battery depth-of-discharge (DoD ≤ 30%), and link budgets. Launches remain interlocked until all physical constraints evaluate positive.

2. 60 FPS 3D Terrestrial & Orbital Flight Arena: Runs entirely client-side via Three.js WebGL. Players control real multi-stage rockets through Tsiolkovsky staging (SRB jettison, MECO, fairing deployment above 105 km, SECO), followed by in-orbit operations:

- Solar Alignment: Demystifies photovoltaic cosine efficiency (P = Pmax · cos θ) via live HUD solar compass; pressing [S] slews attitude to lock 100% solar flux.

- Laser Optical Downlink: Observation buffers flush to NASA DSN / ISRO ISTRAC ground stations using directional data lasers [T].

- Conical Nadir Ground Swaths: Visualizes why sensors fail when empty; instrument ground tracks target real surface coordinates.

- 3D Conjunction & Space Traffic Avoidance: Alerts when active satellites (Iridium-33, Cosmos-2251) enter proximity, requiring deflector shielding [Q] or orbital maneuvering.

- 3D Heliocentric Celestial Orrery: Explores all 8 planets revolving under Kepler's 3rd Law (T² ∝ a³) around an animated coronal noise Sun.

TOOLS, LANGUAGES & SOFTWARE USED:

- Core Engine: Vanilla JavaScript (ES6 Modules), HTML5, CSS3 Glassmorphism

- 3D Graphics: Three.js (r128) WebGL with custom PBR and GLSL fragment shaders (day/night smoothstep terminator, inverted Fresnel Rayleigh atmospheric scattering, and procedural solar noise)

- Audio: Web Audio API (synthesized telemetry pings, rocket rumble, klaxons)

- Version Control & Deployment: Git, GitHub, Surge CDN Edge Networks

- Textures & Cartography: NASA Visible Earth Blue Marble, NASA Earth Observatory Night Lights, and USGS Planetary GIS

WHAT BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT DOES IT HAVE?

Most space education games are either abstract calculators or unphysical arcade titles. SPACE-AURA teaches authentic aerospace tradeoffs—such as why mass margins dictate scientific payload capability, why satellites coast along gravitational geodesics rather than "following roads," and how international partnerships (NASA-ISRO NISAR) address planetary challenges like glacial melt and seismic fault monitoring.

CREATIVITY & FACTORS CONSIDERED:

- Zero Barrier to Entry: No plugins, installs, or logins; runs at 60 FPS across laptops, desktops, and interactive classroom displays.

- Authentic International Flagships: Features real NASA and ISRO missions (NISAR, Chandrayaan-3, Aditya-L1, Mangalyaan, Artemis II Orion, JWST).

- Cyberpunk Tactical HUD: Astra Nexus-inspired aerospace aesthetic that turns complex engineering data into clear, intuitive tactical instruments.
